lines.text: Solomon gathered Israel's elders to bring up the ark of the covenant from Zion, and the priests and Levites carried it.
Solomon and all Israel sacrificed sheep and oxen before the ark, and the priests set it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
The ark held only the two stone tablets that Aaron had placed in it at Horeb.
The cloud filled the house of the LORD, so the priests could not stand to minister because of the LORD's fear.
Solomon blessed the whole assembly and said the LORD told David that his son would build the house for His Name.
